content.cardTitle: Every Living Being Deserves Care & Dignity
content.cardText: Project Pashu is a compassionate animal welfare initiative dedicated to the care, protection, and well-being of animals in need. Through feeding drives, medical assistance, rescue support, and community awareness, the initiative works to ensure that vulnerable animals receive the care, safety, and compassion they deserve.
content.aboutHeading: Protecting & Caring For Our Voiceless Companions
content.mission: Project Pashu is committed to improving the lives of animals through care, protection, feeding support, medical assistance, and awareness initiatives that promote kindness and responsible coexistence.
content.whyItMatters: Countless animals face hunger, injury, illness, abandonment, and cruelty every day. Project Pashu works to reduce suffering and create safer, healthier environments where animals can live with dignity and care.

services.title: Feeding Drives
services.desc: Regular food distribution and clean water support for stray, abandoned, and vulnerable animals.

services.title: Medical Assistance
services.desc: Treatment support, emergency care, first aid, and veterinary coordination for injured and sick animals.

services.title: Preventive Care
services.desc: Promoting animal health, safety awareness, and humane treatment through community engagement.

services.title: Seasonal Protection
services.desc: Water bowls, shelter support, and weather protection during extreme summer, monsoon, and winter conditions.

content.beneficiariesHeading: Supporting Animals In Need Of Care & Protection
content.impactHeading: Creating A More Humane & Compassionate Society

impact.title: Reduced Animal Suffering
impact.desc: Providing timely food, care, and medical support to improve the quality of life for vulnerable animals.

impact.title: Community Awareness
impact.desc: Encouraging compassion, responsible coexistence, and reporting of cruelty, neglect, and injury cases.

impact.title: Protection & Care
impact.desc: Creating safer environments where animals receive respect, dignity, and protection throughout their lives.

content.ctaTitle: Join The Mission To Protect Every Life
content.ctaText: Every meal provided, every animal treated, and every act of kindness brings us closer to a world where compassion extends to all living beings. Together, we can create safer and more caring communities for animals.
